meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 它把消息渠道接到 agent 群组上:登记新渠道、增删接线、调整隔离级别,并汇总显示已接、已配置未接和未配置的渠道。
howto.when: 在你刚添加一个渠道之后、初始设置过程中,或想单独重新配置接线时使用。

say.text: 帮我看看现在哪些渠道已经接好了、哪些还没配
say.note: 输出渠道与 agent 群组的配置摘要

say.text: 把这个新的 Telegram 群接到我的 agent 上
say.note: 会先问隔离方式,再登记接线

say.text: 把 Slack 渠道从旧 agent 群组换到新的

howto.what_en: It wires messaging channels to agent groups: registering new channels, adding or removing wirings, adjusting isolation levels, and showing a summary of wired, configured-but-unwired, and unconfigured channels.
howto.when_en: Use it after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure channels and group wirings.

say_en.text: Show me which channels are wired and which aren't yet
Wire this new Telegram group to my agent
say_en.note: Asks the isolation question, then registers

say_en.text: Move the Slack channel from the old agent group to the new one
say_en.note: Rewires; old sessions stay with the old group
